objective: Turn private and explicitly contributed mathematics resources into reliable progressive teaching, assessment, simulation, remediation, and institution-specific learning intelligence.

architecture.rationale: Known private-learning, contribution, library, tutoring, and assessment routes need separate schemas, evaluations, permissions, and state policies while sharing one Atlas identity.
simpler_options_rejected: Deterministic code alone cannot interpret varied documents or teach open-ended mathematics.
A single model call cannot safely perform ingestion, validation, progression, exam construction, and remediation.
One linear workflow cannot represent the distinct user-selected product routes.

capabilities.verification: Verify ownership, idempotency, schemas, counts, and evidence anchors.
Verify tenant, resource, page, region, and extraction version.
capabilities.rationale: Teaching and highlighting must remain grounded.

capabilities.verification: Validate canonical IDs, aliases, confidence, evidence, and taxonomy version.
Run deterministic fixtures and store an immutable snapshot.
capabilities.rationale: Patterns are reproducible high-value application logic.

capabilities.verification: Validate structured output, evidence, confidence, and transition before persistence.
capabilities.rationale: Tutoring needs bounded interpretation and durable state.

capabilities.verification: Validate typed inputs, output, time, and tool-call identifier.
Validate schema, expressions, render result, and result pairing.
capabilities.rationale: Visual explanations need a bounded tool loop.

capabilities.verification: Validate blueprint, schema, marks, uniqueness, solvability, and publication.
capabilities.rationale: Exam creation is a known multi-stage workflow.

capabilities.verification: Check schema, mark-scheme agreement, totals, confidence, and persistence.
capabilities.rationale: Marking requires explicit evidence and uncertainty.

capabilities.verification: Verify source exam, question, concept, diagnosis, objective, and completion criteria.
capabilities.rationale: A durable assignment closes the assessment loop.

capabilities.verification: Verify private ownership, explicit versioned consent, rights attestation, confirmed institution/course metadata, and immutable submission state.
capabilities.rationale: Contribution must be a separate explicit act from private upload.

capabilities.verification: Require accepted privacy, duplicate, rights, eligibility, metadata, and quality checks; publish under an explicit access policy and verify visibility.
capabilities.rationale: Shared-library publication needs governed review rather than model autonomy.

capabilities.verification: Require an accepted contribution, idempotency key, reward policy version, and entitlement readback.
capabilities.rationale: Benefits create the network incentive but must follow accepted value.

capabilities.verification: Verify user entitlement, institution/course scope, approved source status, allowed use, and takedown status on every read.
capabilities.rationale: Authorized institution evidence improves lecturer-specific tutoring and simulation.

sources: explicit contribution consent and rights attestations
data.retention: Define cascading account deletion, contribution withdrawal, library takedown, entitlement policy, and derived-snapshot invalidation before production; retain only minimal versioned audit references without secrets.

policies.clarification: Clarify or review ambiguous regions, transcriptions, institution/course metadata, rights status, concept matches, or student answers.
policies.abstention: Do not publish extraction or contributions, grant rewards, promote mastery, publish an exam, or assign marks below the route's evidence and authorization threshold.
policies.approval: Private upload is not contribution consent; contribution requires explicit versioned user approval, shared publication requires an accepted review, and destructive deletion requires explicit confirmation.
policies.environment_inspection: Derive identity from the token and inspect ownership, consent, contribution eligibility, library entitlement, takedown status, state, quota, and version before every read or write.
policies.postcondition_verification: Read back and validate identifiers, status, counts, publication visibility, entitlements, links, and transitions after mutations.

metrics: latency, calls, tokens, cost, retries, and abstentions
critical_failures: publication of leaked, personally identifying, or ineligible content

excluded_capabilities.reason: Routes and transitions are known and independently evaluable.
excluded_capabilities.evidence_to_add: Cases showing valid tool sequences must vary dynamically.

excluded_capabilities.reason: No measured isolation or specialization benefit.
excluded_capabilities.evidence_to_add: Stable parent contract and measured specialist improvement.

excluded_capabilities.reason: Deterministic institution, course, resource, concept, and access filters plus lexical lookup are more reliable initially.
excluded_capabilities.evidence_to_add: Retrieval evals showing authorized scoped lookup cannot find appropriate material.
Approved sourced-information feature with citation evals.
Reviewed tasks bounded math tools cannot solve.

residual_risks: Inaccurate contributor rights attestations and takedown exposure
Institution and lecturer privacy or misclassification
Incentive-driven spam, duplicates, manipulation, or leaked assessments
